description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Azure Cosmos DB clustering in Orleans. It provides methods to add Cosmos-based clustering and gateway list providers to silo and client builders, as well as service collections, facilitating dependency injection and configuration setup.

classes.name: HostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Orleans clustering with Azure Cosmos DB.

methods.name: UseCosmosClustering
methods.description: Configures Orleans silo builder to use Cosmos DB for clustering, with overloads for different configuration approaches.

methods.name: UseCosmosGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Configures Orleans client builder or service collection to use Cosmos DB for gateway list provisioning, with overloads for different configuration approaches.
